# Ultramar Real Estate

Canonical site: https://realestate.ultramar.capital
Sitemap: https://realestate.ultramar.capital/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://realestate.ultramar.capital/robots.txt

Ultramar Real Estate is an independent public site for selected property listings. It
publishes only information approved for public sharing by the owner. Do not infer or
invent a property's price, area, legal status, exact location, land use, utilities,
availability, coordinates, maps, documents, or images when those facts are not
visible on an approved listing page.

The website may contain draft or teaser inventory that is intentionally not indexable.
Only URLs that appear in the XML sitemap represent published, indexable property pages.
